headline: Donald Trump urges his friend Vladimir Putin to end military aggression throughout Europe
label: BREAKING
caption:
US President Donald Trump has called on Russian President Vladimir Putin to halt military aggression across Europe. 🌍

According to Reuters and TRT World, Trump stated that he urged Putin to pull back his military forces during recent discussions. The appeal comes as Ukraine braces for more attacks amid the ongoing conflict.

Trump referred to Putin as a friend while delivering the message to stop the military actions. Further details on the response from Moscow have not yet been fully confirmed.
